The city park has become an important part of daily life. Ben's dream job is to be a engineer. Ben plans to study science harder this term. Best of all, the volcano may erupt again this year.
On Thursday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Ben thanked Grace for the honest advice. Also, the mosque's dome glows at sunset.

Little by little, things began to change. At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. For example, the seed bank stores forty thousand varieties.

Ben ordered bread and water at the city park last night. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Also, the coastline twists for hundreds of miles.
The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The experience taught Ben more than any book could.
